fault: Kill one primary server while a worker has already Pulled but not Pushed
observed_outcome: Survivors promoted and training resumed; final fixed-gradient weights matched the independent offline oracle
tested_guarantee: Exactly-once effects for all recorded acknowledged logical Pushes under one confirmed crash-stop failure
known_limit: Single failed server, live manager, k=1, and no concurrent network partition

fault: Kill source server after staging its E1 transfer
observed_outcome: Unpublished destination data was discarded, old source partition promoted, old Task IDs deduplicated, and replication repaired
tested_guarantee: Prepublication single-source crash rolls back staging without losing acknowledged state
known_limit: Migration globally write-fenced; this is not a fully online E1 transfer

fault: Kill destination server after transfer staging
observed_outcome: Old source range remained authoritative; failed destination's own range was promoted and writes resumed
tested_guarantee: Prepublication destination loss does not publish speculative transfer state
known_limit: Only one server crash; staging protocol requires surviving replicas

fault: Kill source after publishing a partial range migration
observed_outcome: Migration repair refused to release write fences; ownership epoch was not republished
tested_guarantee: Safety by rejecting writes while retained subranges cannot be reconstructed; NOT availability
known_limit: Partial postpublication source crash is NOT recovered; training can remain blocked

fault: Kill real worker subprocess while another is blocked under bounded delay tau=1
observed_outcome: Manager excluded dead worker; surviving worker resumed and exactly three acknowledged gradients determined final weights
tested_guarantee: Timed-out worker cannot stall bounded-delay gate indefinitely; historical progress retained
known_limit: No per-worker fencing at the parameter-server Push layer for late in-flight requests

fault: Delay an actual Push RPC before forwarding to the real primary
observed_outcome: Both Pushes acknowledged, applied once and replicated in sequence
tested_guarantee: Finite client-to-server request delay changes latency but not Push or backup state
known_limit: Test shim creates a controlled delay, not arbitrary network reordering

fault: Drop first Push before network forwarding; retry unchanged Task ID
observed_outcome: First attempt produced no update; successful replay applied and replicated once
tested_guarantee: One dropped request followed by a Task-ID-preserving retry does not double-apply
known_limit: One-shot test-only drop; not indefinite link partition or uncontrolled loss rate

fault: Deliver Push and let primary+backup commit, then discard client-visible ACK
observed_outcome: Replayed identical Task ID returned accepted without another update on primary or replica
tested_guarantee: ACK loss after committed Push is idempotent under retry of identical Task ID
known_limit: Retry must preserve Task ID and identical request payload

observed_outcome: Unpublished migration aborted without changing epoch; subsequent acknowledged Push replicated once
tested_guarantee: Missing staging RPC cannot expose an incomplete new ownership epoch
known_limit: Manager and original source remain available
